objective: Turn independently approved stopped development feedback into an explicitly metered, unvalidated model-inference draft using only MockTransport.

implementation.inputs: Original crash.log, all registered candidate patch.diff texts, complete aggregate and manifest, original permission and declared ancestor lineages. Actual UTF-8 bytes, paths, hashes and candidate identities are retained. No full engineering source, Graph, SQLite, hidden labels or full original model dialogue is sent.
implementation.source_admission: Original capsule is fully reaggregated before mutable ledger access. Host approval binds provider settings, one operation/run, budgets and a precreated physical learning root. All frozen knowledge entries contribute declared ancestor lineages, including entries not retrieved in the original run.
implementation.dispatch: Pure adapter.validate checks exact MockTransport and full request before durable dispatch; invoke repeats admission at the wire boundary. Requests and ledger rows must have exact correspondence. Missing original database, deleted rows or changed complete requests cannot become fresh unsent requests.
implementation.recovery: Completed same-ID calls replay read-only; reserved preflight failures remain unsent and charged against call count; dispatched/unknown calls never auto-resend. One extraction position and explicit invalid-parent format repairs; new IDs cannot duplicate the same complete request or repair already valid guidance.
implementation.draft: Canonical immutable LearningDraft retains owner, all complete requests/records/responses, exact original cost prefix, permission and declared lineage. Guidance stays model_inference, has no validation scopes, remains pending_host_review, and grants no tools or application qualification. Ordinary summary/invoke also reaudits existing drafts.
implementation.usage: Known tokens are a lower bound when dispatch or usage is unknown, missing or invalid; total remains null. Monetary fees are unknown. Format failures and repairs remain in the denominator.
implementation.root_binding: Real path plus device, inode and directory type; mutable non-identity attributes are excluded, but each observation independently rejects non-directory, symlink, reparse or unavailable inode. Original shared directory anchor and capacity assertions were not changed.
implementation.limits: Original file/tree/read budgets and conservative finite mock-response/SQLite headroom. Not all internal aggregation I/O, peak memory, hard actual token costs, global one-time authorization, or cross-operation and learning/deployment budget accounting.

workflow.scope: Executed before the local root-identity helper refinement; complete wire texts, explicit repair, replay, preflight, unknown dispatch, usage and shared budget. Final audit exercises normal owner/invoke paths after the refinement.

audit_initial.failure: Capacity counterexample encountered unequal root-binding observations before reaching the headroom guard; the differing tuple fields were not captured, so no Archive-attribute cause is asserted.

audit_final.capacity: Original headroom exception, no-send and empty-root assertions unchanged and passed.

tests.warning: learning_workflow_support was imported before plugin assertion rewriting. Warnings retained; assertions remain in collected test modules.
tests.prefix_test_scope: The unknown/future-cost counterexample constructs unit records; it is not accepted stopped-run evidence or a legitimate exercised post-Draft provider append.

quality.semantic_review: Registered new modules/tests and distinguished independent Mock drafts from old manual not_run versions. Six stale specification statements were replaced in the original body; derivation, deployment, portable recovery and end-to-end budget limitations remain explicit.

environment.cleanup: Manager reclaimed successful test temporary material. Failed/interrupted records and pre-existing evidence remain; no broad cleanup was performed.

remaining: Explicit approval and compatible model-derived version/projection/Agent startup bridge; do not relabel model inference as host-curated
